## Personal and passport details

**[B01] Surname**

SURNAME_P1

**[B02] Given and middle names**

GIVEN_P1

MIDDLE_P1

After the values are restored, enter both names in the same blank in the order shown in your passport.

**[B03] Other names** — NEEDS-YOU. Confirm whether you have ever used any other names.

**[B04] Date of birth**

DATE_P1

After the value is restored, enter it in day/month/year order.

**[B05] Place of birth**

PLACE_P1

After the value is restored, put the city, state or province, and country in the corresponding parts of the field. Supply any missing component by hand.

**[B06] Sex** — Tick Female.  
**[B07] Marital status** — Tick Single.  
**[B08] Nationality or citizenship** — Filipino  
**[B09] Former or other nationalities or citizenships** — NEEDS-YOU. Confirm whether you have any to report.  
**[B10] Government-issued ID number** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the applicable government-issued ID number directly on the form.  
**[B11] Passport type** — NEEDS-YOU. Check the passport and tick its category.

**[B12] Passport number**

ID_P1

**[B13] Place of issue** — NEEDS-YOU. Check the passport for the place of issue. The information supplied gives the issuing country.

**[B14] Date of issue**

ISSUED_P1

After the value is restored, enter it in day/month/year order.

**[B15] Issuing authority**

AUTHORITY_P1

**[B16] Date of expiry** — 13/03/2032  
**[B17] Certificate of Eligibility number** — NEEDS-YOU. Confirm whether you have a certificate and enter its number if applicable.

## Guarantor and inviter

For **[B33]**, confirm whether you have a guarantor or reference in Japan. For **[B34]**, confirm whether you have an inviter. If the inviter and guarantor are the same person, write “same as above” in B34 as directed by the form. Where a person’s details apply, complete the corresponding fields by hand.

| Detail | [B33] Guarantor or reference | [B34] Inviter |
